title: Pludux Backtest Model Schema

version.title: Model JSON format version 1
version.description: Version of the Pludux Model JSON format. Must be 1.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Backtest execution assumptions shared by both position sides.

series.title: Named Series
series.description: A dictionary of reusable named series. Each key must be lower_snake_case. Define indicators, transformed price series, and intermediate calculations here so positions, signals, and plots can reference them consistently. When one named series needs the numeric output of another named series, use SERIES. When a method needs the named series definition itself, use SERIES.

long.title: Long Side
long.description: Rules for opening, sizing, and closing long positions. Set to false to disable long trading.

short.title: Short Side
short.description: Rules for opening, sizing, and closing short positions. Set to false to disable short trading.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Trading rules for long and short positions. Each side can be disabled with false, or configured with entry rules, an explicit risk distance, and optional executable exits.

plots.title: Plots
plots.description: Optional visual plot groups for chart rendering. Plot groups can be overlaid on price or rendered in their own pane.

pyramidingRetrigger.title: Pyramiding Retrigger
pyramidingRetrigger.description: EVERY_EVALUATION allows another pyramiding entry whenever the signal is true at an eligible evaluation. AFTER_FALSE allows one entry per true period and requires a false evaluation before the signal can trigger again.

valueRepresentation.title: Value Representation
valueRepresentation.description: Numeric representation format for a numeric input. Decimal allows floating-point values. SignedInteger restricts to integer values including negative. UnsignedInteger restricts to non-negative integer values.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Boolean signal definition for this entry rule. It can be an inline signal object or a literal true/false value.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: Entry rule for this side. The entry signal decides when to open a position.

exits.title: Signal Exits
exits.description: Timed signal-exit rules with configurable activation semantics.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Boolean signal definition for this pyramiding rule. It can be an inline signal object or a literal true/false value.

cooldown.title: Cooldown Bars
cooldown.description: Number of complete bars after each accepted entry during which all pyramiding processing is paused. Zero disables the cooldown.

maxLayers.title: Max Layers
maxLayers.description: Maximum number of pyramiding layers allowed. For example, maxLayers 3 means the initial position plus 2 additional layers.

favorable.title: Favorable SL/TP Reference
favorable.description: Reference price used by stop/target methods when the pyramiding entry is favorable relative to the current average and position direction.

unfavorable.title: Unfavorable SL/TP Reference
unfavorable.description: Reference price used by stop/target methods when the pyramiding entry is unfavorable relative to the current average and position direction.

riskDistance.title: 1R Risk Distance
riskDistance.description: Required positive distance expression used for risk-based sizing and R-multiple stop/target prices. This value does not execute a stop-loss order.

stopLosses.title: Stop Losses
stopLosses.description: Executable stop-loss rules with configurable activation semantics.

takeProfits.title: Take Profits
takeProfits.description: Take-profit rules with configurable activation semantics.

positionSide.title: Position Side
positionSide.description: Configuration for one trading direction, such as long or short. Use false to disable the side, or provide entry rules plus a required explicit 1R risk distance.

riskDistance.title: 1R Risk Distance
riskDistance.description: An explicit method object that evaluates to a finite positive 1R price distance.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the model exits the position when price reaches the stop price.

trailing.title: Trailing
trailing.description: When true, the stop-loss exit trails favorable price movement instead of staying fixed.

stopPrice.title: Stop Price
stopPrice.description: Required executable stop-price expression. It is independent from the position's riskDistance.

stopLoss.title: Stop Loss
stopLoss.description: One executable stop-loss rule in the ordered stopLosses collection. Position sizing and R-multiple prices use riskDistance instead.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this signal-exit rule may execute.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Boolean signal definition for this exit rule.

signalExit.title: Signal Exit
signalExit.description: A signal-driven partial or full exit that may execute once per open position.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the model exits the position when price reaches the target price.

targetPrice.title: Target Price
targetPrice.description: Price expression for the profit target. It can be a constant, a raw price series, a named series, or an inline series expression.

takeProfit.title: Take Profit
takeProfit.description: Profit-side configuration for a position. When enabled is true, the evaluated target price is used as the take-profit exit level.

exitReduce.title: Position Reduction
exitReduce.description: Fraction of the remaining position to close when this exit triggers. A value of 1 closes the full remaining position.

seriesAsParameter.title: Series Input (Flexible Expression)
seriesAsParameter.description:
Represents an input that can be a constant, a raw price series, a previously defined named series, or an inline series expression.

Authoring preference (IMPORTANT for AI generation):
1. Prefer using SERIES to reference a named series defined in top-level 'series'.
2. Prefer full method objects (e.g., EMA, RSI) when parameters are customized.
3. Use quote shorthand (e.g., "CLOSE") only for raw OHLCV inputs.
4. Use indicator shorthand (e.g., "EMA") ONLY when the default parameters are intended exactly.
5. Use plain numbers only for constant values.

Consistency rule:
- Prefer defining reusable logic in top-level 'series' and referencing it via SERIES instead of repeating inline expressions.

Discouraged but valid:
- Mixing multiple styles in the same model (e.g., sometimes using shorthand, sometimes full objects).
- Using indicator shorthand when custom parameters are needed.

This flexibility exists for convenience, but AI-generated models should follow a consistent style using named series and explicit method definitions.

oneOf.description: Quote shorthand representing raw market data. Preferred only for direct price/volume inputs.

Backtest-state shorthand. EQUITY reads the account equity available at the current evaluation moment. EQUITY_PERCENT reads that equity as a percentage of initial capital. DRAWDOWN reads the account drawdown available at the current evaluation moment. PYRAMIDING_LAYER reads the accepted position layer count, using 0 while flat.
A full series expression using method + params. Preferred when defining indicators or transformations.
Indicator shorthand with default parameters. Convenience syntax only. Avoid using this if any parameter customization is required.

examples.description: Preferred: raw price input using quote shorthand
Preferred: referencing a previously defined series
Preferred: explicit indicator with custom parameters
Allowed but discouraged unless default parameters are intended exactly

method.title: Method
method.description: Uppercase dot-qualified method identifier. Dots separate semantic namespaces and underscores separate words.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Method-specific parameters. The required keys depend on the method.

baseMethod.title: Base Method Object
baseMethod.description: Base shape shared by Pludux method objects. Most series, signals, and plots are expressed as an object with a UPPERCASE method name and an optional params object.

quoteMethod.title: Quote Series
quoteMethod.description: Built-in market data series from the current bar, such as OPEN, HIGH, LOW, CLOSE, or VOLUME.

method.title: Method
method.description: Always use SERIES to reference a named series.

name.title: Series Name
name.description: Name of a previously defined series in the top-level series object.

seriesMethod.title: Series
seriesMethod.description: References a previously defined named series. At the current bar it evaluates the named series; for historical bars it reads the cached completed result.

output.title: Output Name
output.description: Which output line to select from the source series, such as upper-band, lower-band, macd-line, signal-line, or histogram.

source.title: Source Series
source.description: Source multi-output series. Use a multi-output indicator directly, or use SERIES to refer to a named multi-output series.

selectOutputMethod.title: Select Output
selectOutputMethod.description: Selects one named output from a multi-output series, such as Bollinger Bands, MACD, STOCH, or STOCH_RSI. The source should usually be a multi-output indicator definition directly, or a SERIES reference to a named multi-output series.

source.title: Source Series
source.description: Series to read from a previous bar.

period.title: Lookback Period
period.description: Number of bars to look back. 0 means the current bar, 1 means one bar ago, and so on.

lookbackMethod.title: Lookback
lookbackMethod.description: Returns the value of a source series from a previous bar. For example, period 1 means one bar ago.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for the input parameter, shown in the UI.

representation.title: Representation
representation.description: Value format constraint. Decimal (default) allows any floating-point number. SignedInteger restricts values to whole numbers including negative. UnsignedInteger restricts to non-negative whole numbers.

value.title: Value
value.description: The numeric value of the input. When representation is SignedInteger or UnsignedInteger, this value is normalized by the system (truncated toward zero, or clamped to zero for unsigned).

inputMethod.title: Model Input
inputMethod.description: Defines an inline numeric input parameter. Backtests collect INPUT nodes from series and signals in traversal order and may override their values.

value.title: Value
value.description: Constant numeric value to use as a series.

valueMethod.title: Value
valueMethod.description: Wraps a constant number as a series object.

field.title: Field Name
field.description: Name of the custom dataset field to read.

dataMethod.title: Data Field
dataMethod.description: Reads a custom data field from the input dataset, such as a user-provided column in the historical data file.

equityMethod.title: Equity
equityMethod.description: Reads the account equity available at the current evaluation moment.

equityPercentMethod.title: Equity Percent
equityPercentMethod.description: Reads account equity available at the current evaluation moment as a percentage of initial capital.

drawdownMethod.title: Drawdown
drawdownMethod.description: Reads the account drawdown available at the current evaluation moment.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used by the indicator.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used as the indicator input.

smaMethod.title: Simple Moving Average
smaMethod.description: Calculates the simple moving average of a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used by the indicator.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used as the indicator input.

emaMethod.title: Exponential Moving Average
emaMethod.description: Calculates the exponential moving average of a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used by the indicator.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used as the indicator input.

rmaMethod.title: Running Moving Average
rmaMethod.description: Calculates Wilder's running moving average of a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used by the indicator.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used as the indicator input.

wmaMethod.title: Weighted Moving Average
wmaMethod.description: Calculates the weighted moving average of a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used by the indicator.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used as the indicator input.

hmaMethod.title: Hull Moving Average
hmaMethod.description: Calculates the Hull moving average of a source series over a lookback period.

maMethod.title: Moving Average Series
maMethod.description: Union of supported moving-average method objects.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used by the indicator.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used as the indicator input.

rsiMethod.title: Relative Strength Index
rsiMethod.description: Calculates the RSI oscillator from a source series.

maSmoothingType.title: Smoothing Type
maSmoothingType.description: Moving-average smoothing method used to smooth true range into ATR.

atrMethod.title: Average True Range
atrMethod.description: Calculates ATR as a volatility measure using a chosen smoothing method.

period.title: Period
period.description: Rolling window length for the standard deviation calculation.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series whose dispersion is measured.

stddevMethod.title: Standard Deviation
stddevMethod.description: Calculates rolling standard deviation of a source series.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used to compute the highest value.

highestMethod.title: Highest
highestMethod.description: Calculates the highest value of a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used to compute the lowest value.

lowestMethod.title: Lowest
lowestMethod.description: Calculates the lowest value of a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used for the rate-of-change calculation.

rocMethod.title: Rate of Change
rocMethod.description: Calculates percentage rate of change for a source series over a lookback period.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used to compute relative volume.

rvolMethod.title: Relative Volume
rvolMethod.description: Calculates relative volume by comparing current volume to average volume over a lookback period.

trMethod.title: True Range
trMethod.description: Calculates true range for the current bar.

maType.title: Moving Average Type
maType.description: Moving average method used for the Bollinger Bands middle line.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period for the middle band and standard deviation.

stddev.title: Standard Deviation Multiplier
stddev.description: Number of standard deviations used to place the upper and lower bands.

maSource.title: Moving Average Source
maSource.description: Source series used to calculate the Bollinger Bands.

bbMethod.title: Bollinger Bands
bbMethod.description: Calculates a multi-output Bollinger Bands series with upper, middle, and lower bands.

maSource.title: maSource
maSource.description: Source series used for the Keltner Channel center line.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period for the center-line moving average.

maMethodType.title: maMethodType
maMethodType.description: Moving average method used for the center line.

bandMethodType.title: bandMethodType
bandMethodType.description: Volatility method used for the channel width. ATR uses average true range, TR uses true range, and RangeHighLow uses raw high-low range.

bandAtrPeriod.title: Band ATR Period
bandAtrPeriod.description: ATR period used when bandMethodType is ATR.

multiplier.title: Multiplier
multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the band width.

kcMethod.title: Keltner Channel
kcMethod.description: Calculates a multi-output Keltner Channel series using a moving average center line and a volatility band method.

period.title: Period
period.description: Lookback period used to calculate the Donchian Channel.

donchianChannelMethod.title: Donchian Channel
donchianChannelMethod.description: Calculates a multi-output Donchian Channel series with upper and lower bands based on the highest high and lowest low over a lookback period.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source series used for the MACD calculation.

macdMethod.title: INDICATOR.MACD
macdMethod.description: Calculates a multi-output MACD series with MACD line, signal line, and histogram.

kPeriod.title: K Period
kPeriod.description: Lookback period used to compute raw %K.

high.title: high
high.description: Series used as the high input.

low.title: low
low.description: Series used as the low input.

close.title: close
close.description: Series used as the close input.

stochMethod.title: Stochastic Oscillator
stochMethod.description: Calculates a multi-output stochastic oscillator with %K and %D outputs.

kPeriod.title: K Period
kPeriod.description: Lookback period used to compute raw stochastic values on RSI.

rsiSource.title: rsiSource
rsiSource.description: Source series used to calculate RSI before applying stochastic.

stochRsiMethod.title: Stochastic RSI
stochRsiMethod.description: Calculates a multi-output stochastic RSI oscillator with %K and %D outputs.

augend.title: Augend
augend.description: First numeric input to add. Prefer SERIES for named series and plain numbers for constants.

addend.title: Addend
addend.description: Second numeric input to add. Prefer SERIES for named series and plain numbers for constants.

params.title: Parameters
params.description:
Parameters for addition.

Authoring preference (IMPORTANT for AI generation):
1. Prefer SERIES for named series inputs.
2. Prefer plain numbers for constants.
3. Prefer naming reusable arithmetic expressions in top-level 'series' instead of repeating them inline.

addMethod.title: Add
addMethod.description: Returns the sum of two numeric inputs.

minuend.title: Minuend
minuend.description: Value to subtract from. Prefer SERIES for named series.

subtrahend.title: Subtrahend
subtrahend.description: Value to subtract. Prefer SERIES for named series and numbers for constants.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for subtraction. Prefer reusable named series instead of repeated inline expressions.

subtractMethod.title: Subtract
subtractMethod.description: Returns the result of subtracting one numeric input from another.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for multiplication. Prefer SERIES for named series and plain numbers for constants such as 2, 0.5, or 100.

multiplyMethod.title: Multiply
multiplyMethod.description: Returns the product of two numeric inputs.

divisor.title: Divisor
divisor.description: Numeric value used as the divisor. Ensure the divisor is intended to be non-zero at runtime.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for division. Prefer SERIES for named series and plain numbers for constants.

divideMethod.title: Divide
divideMethod.description: Returns one numeric input divided by another.

operand.title: Operand
operand.description: Numeric value to multiply by -1. Prefer SERIES for named series.

negateMethod.title: Negate
negateMethod.description: Returns the negative of a numeric input.

operand.title: Operand
operand.description: Numeric value whose square root is calculated.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for square root. Use only when the runtime values are intended to be non-negative.

sqrtMethod.title: Square Root
sqrtMethod.description: Returns the square root of a numeric input.

unaryScalarMethod.title: Unary Scalar Operator
unaryScalarMethod.description: Applies absolute-value or positive/negative-part extraction to one numeric operand.

extremaMethod.title: Extrema Operator
extremaMethod.description: Returns the maximum or minimum of two numeric operands.

source.title: Source
source.description: Numeric source whose bar-to-bar change is calculated. Prefer SERIES for named series and quote shorthand for raw OHLCV inputs.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for bar-to-bar change. Prefer defining reusable source logic in top-level 'series' when the same source is used in multiple places.

changeMethod.title: Change
changeMethod.description: Returns the bar-to-bar difference of a numeric source.

minuend.title: Minuend
minuend.description: First numeric input in the absolute-difference calculation.

subtrahend.title: Subtrahend
subtrahend.description: Second numeric input in the absolute-difference calculation.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for absolute difference. Prefer SERIES for named series and numbers for constants.

absDiffMethod.title: Absolute Difference
absDiffMethod.description: Returns the absolute value of the difference between two numeric inputs.

base.title: Base
base.description: Base numeric input that the percentage is applied to. Prefer quote shorthand for direct OHLCV input and SERIES for named series.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: Percentage amount to apply, such as 2 for 2%.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters for percentage-of-base calculation. This is commonly used for offsets, thresholds, and derived levels.

percentageMethod.title: Percentage of Base
percentageMethod.description: Returns a percentage of a base numeric input.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Absolute price distance from the entry price.

stopTargetAmountMethod.title: Stop/Target Amount
stopTargetAmountMethod.description: Calculates an absolute stop-loss or take-profit price from entry price and fixed amount.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: Percentage distance from the entry price, such as 10 for 10%.

stopTargetPercentageMethod.title: Stop/Target Percentage
stopTargetPercentageMethod.description: Calculates an absolute stop-loss or take-profit price from entry price and percentage distance.

maSmoothingType.title: Smoothing Type
maSmoothingType.description: Moving-average smoothing method used to smooth true range into ATR.

stopTargetAtrMethod.title: Stop/Target ATR
stopTargetAtrMethod.description: Calculates an absolute stop-loss or take-profit price from entry price and ATR distance.

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: Positive percentage of the active position reference price.

stopLoss1RMethod.title: Stop Loss 1R
stopLoss1RMethod.description: Stop price exactly one explicit riskDistance from the configured reference price.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: Positive risk multiple of the explicit riskDistance.

stopLossRMultipleMethod.title: Stop Loss R Multiple
stopLossRMultipleMethod.description: Calculates an absolute stop-loss price from the active reference price and explicit riskDistance.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: Positive reward multiple of the explicit riskDistance.

takeProfitRMultipleMethod.title: Take Profit R Multiple
takeProfitRMultipleMethod.description: Calculates an absolute take-profit price from the active reference price and explicit riskDistance.

positionContextValueMethod.title: Position Context Value
positionContextValueMethod.description: Reads a backtest position-context value. Price and direction methods return NaN outside an active position; PYRAMIDING_LAYER returns 0 while flat and the accepted layer count while open.

source.title: Source
source.description: Price or numeric series compared with the position risk reference price. Defaults to CLOSE.

positionRMultipleMethod.title: Current Position R-Multiple
positionRMultipleMethod.description: Returns direction times the difference between the source and active risk reference price, divided by the active positive risk distance. Returns NaN outside active position context.

stopTargetReferencePrice.description: Reference price used when evaluating stop-loss and take-profit methods during pyramiding.

series.title: Series Definition
series.description: Any valid Pludux series definition. This can be a raw market series, indicator, transformation, arithmetic series, SELECT_OUTPUT chain, SERIES reference, or a signal method used as a numeric series. When a signal method is used in series context, true is coerced to 1 and false is coerced to 0.

signalAsParameter.title: Signal Parameter
signalAsParameter.description: A boolean input accepted by entry, exit, and logical signal methods. It can be a signal object or a literal true or false.

items.title: Items
items.description: Signal list to combine. ALL_OF requires every item to be true. ANY_OF requires at least one item to be true.

compositeConditionMethod.title: Composite Signal
compositeConditionMethod.description: Combines one or more signals into a grouped condition using ALL_OF or ANY_OF.

method.title: Comparison Method
method.description: Comparison operator applied to two numeric inputs.

target.title: Target
target.description: Left-hand numeric input being compared. For AI-generated strategies, prefer SERIES when referring to a previously defined named series. Raw quote shorthand like "CLOSE" is fine for direct market inputs. Avoid repeating complex inline indicator expressions here if they can be defined once in top-level 'series' and reused.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Right-hand numeric input used as the comparison reference. This can be a constant number, raw quote shorthand, another indicator output, or SERIES. Prefer constants for fixed thresholds such as 30, 50, or 70. Prefer SERIES when the threshold comes from another named series.

params.title: Parameters
params.description:
Parameters for a numeric comparison signal.

Authoring preference (IMPORTANT for AI generation):
1. Prefer SERIES when either side refers to a named series.
2. Prefer plain numbers for fixed thresholds.
3. Prefer quote shorthand only for direct OHLCV inputs.
4. Prefer reusing named series instead of repeating inline indicator expressions.

Discouraged but valid:
- Comparing a complex inline indicator on one side when the same logic is reused elsewhere.
- Mixing shorthand and nested styles inconsistently across the same model.

comparisonMethod.title: Comparison Signal
comparisonMethod.description: Boolean signal that compares two numeric values or series over time. Use this for threshold logic such as RSI < 30, CLOSE > EMA, or one named series compared to another.

method.title: Cross Method
method.description: Detects when one numeric series crosses above or below another.

value.title: Value
value.description: The changing numeric series being tested for a cross. For AI-generated strategies, this should usually be a price source, an indicator output, or SERIES referring to a named series.

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: The numeric reference that 'value' is checked against. This is commonly another named indicator output via SERIES, a raw quote series, or a constant threshold.

params.title: Parameters
params.description:
Parameters for a cross signal.

Authoring preference (IMPORTANT for AI generation):
1. Prefer SERIES when crossing one named series against another named series.
2. Prefer quote shorthand only for direct OHLCV inputs.
3. Prefer defining reusable indicators in top-level 'series' and then crossing their SERIES outputs.
4. Use constants only when intentionally crossing against a fixed level.

Discouraged but valid:
- Repeating inline indicator expressions inside CROSSOVER or CROSSUNDER when they could be named once and reused.

crossMethod.title: Cross Signal
crossMethod.description: Boolean signal that detects when one numeric series crosses above or below another numeric series or level.

binaryLogicalMethod.title: Binary Logical Signal
binaryLogicalMethod.description: Combines two signals with AND, OR, or XOR.

unaryLogicalMethod.title: Unary Logical Signal
unaryLogicalMethod.description: Applies NOT to a single signal.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Any valid Pludux signal object. A signal produces boolean values over time and is commonly used for entries, exits, and filters.

namedColor.title: Named Color
namedColor.description: CSS-style named color that can be used for plot styling.

hexColor.title: Hex Color
hexColor.description: Color in CSS hex format, such as #ff0000 or #0f0.

plotColor.title: Plot Color
plotColor.description: Color for a plot item. Can be a named color or an explicit RGBA color object.

plotSource.title: Plot Source
plotSource.description: Source used by a plot item. This can be a series or a signal result that Pludux can render.

name.title: Series Name
name.description: Name of the top-level series to plot.

seriesPlotSource.title: Series Plot Source
seriesPlotSource.description: Plot source that reads the output of a named series by name.

constantPlotSource.title: Constant Plot Source
constantPlotSource.description: Plot source that renders a constant numeric value.

source.title: Source
source.description: Series or signal source to render.

color.title: Color
color.description: Optional color override for this plot item.

linePlot.title: Line Plot
linePlot.description: Plots a source as a line.

level.title: Level
level.description: Y-axis value where the horizontal line is drawn.

color.title: Color
color.description: Optional color override for this plot item.

hlinePlot.title: Horizontal Line Plot
hlinePlot.description: Plots a constant horizontal line at a numeric level.

source.title: Source
source.description: Series or signal source to render.

color.title: Color
color.description: Optional color override for this plot item.

histogramPlot.title: Histogram Plot
histogramPlot.description: Plots a source as histogram bars.

source.title: Source
source.description: Series or signal source to render.

positiveRisingColor.title: Positive Rising Color
positiveRisingColor.description: Color for non-negative bars whose value is rising.

positiveFallingColor.title: Positive Falling Color
positiveFallingColor.description: Color for non-negative bars whose value is falling.

negativeFallingColor.title: Negative Falling Color
negativeFallingColor.description: Color for negative bars whose value is falling.

negativeRisingColor.title: Negative Rising Color
negativeRisingColor.description: Color for negative bars whose value is rising.

momentumHistogramPlot.title: Momentum Histogram Plot
momentumHistogramPlot.description: Plots a source as histogram bars colored by sign and direction.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label shown for the plot group.

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.description: When true, render the plot group on top of the main price chart. When false, render it in a separate pane.

items.title: Items
items.description: Plot items included in this group.

plotGroup.title: Plot Group
plotGroup.description: A group of one or more plot items, optionally overlaid on price.

description: Schema for a Pludux backtest model file. This schema is designed to be machine-validatable and AI-friendly so an AI can generate complete model JSON files with named series, inline numeric inputs, signals, trading rules, and optional chart plots. Use SERIES to reference a named series. For numeric inputs, specify representation (Decimal, SignedInteger, or UnsignedInteger) to constrain how values are formatted and displayed.
